name: A female Bloodmage's helm is hidden while she wears the female worgen display
contract: In-game report: the female worgen form showed a checkered box on the head. Display 142818 (CreatureDisplayInfoExtra 500031, race 13 gender 1) draws the character's own visible gear, and most helm models have no race-13 female variant: of 797 helm stems with a _HuF model in the installed client MPQs only about 211 have _WoF, and a missing variant renders as the placeholder box. The male worgen display 574 is a creature model without gear, so male Bloodmages never show it. Chosen fix: while the female worgen display is active the server sends no head item in PLAYER_VISIBLE_ITEM (entry and enchantment 0), including after a helm is equipped in form, and restores the equipped helm when the form ends. Expected: the visible head entry is the helm before the form, 0 during Running Wild (also after equipping another helm), and a helm again afterwards. visible_item reads the server's visible-item field only; client rendering is not tested.
